sentences.en: The monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
sentences.zh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念这位著名的哲学家而建的。

sentences.en: Philosophers tend to have little contact with the outside world.
sentences.zh: 哲学家们通常与外界接触不多。

sentences.en: Any society not enlightened by philosophers is fooled by quacks.
sentences.zh: 任何没有被哲学家启迪的社会都会被江湖骗子蒙蔽。

senses.zh: 哲学家，哲人,思想家，学者,豁达的人,爱卖弄大道理者
